narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Fixed: `orderTotal` was taxing the pre-discount amount.**

`src/pricing.js` charged tax on the full price, then subtracted the discount separately. It should tax the discounted price.

Fixed in [pricing.js:39-42](src/pricing.js:39).
